theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  split
  · intro h
    rcases Set.mem_image_iff.1 h with ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩
    rw [hf y, hfy]
    exact hy
  · intro h
    rcases Set.mem_image_iff.1 h with ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩
    rw [hf y, hfy]
    exact hy
